E001.Epic Description: Develop secure and intuitive user account management functionalities including SignUp and SignIn, allowing users to register, access, and manage their accounts, thus driving user engagement and platform security.
E001.Story Description: As a new user, I want to be able to sign up for an account so that I can access personalized features and maintain my privacy.
Story Acceptance Criteria: The SignUp page must include fields for name, email, and password.
Passwords must be encrypted before storage.
A confirmation email is sent to the user after successful registration.
An error message is displayed if the signup fails due to an existing email address.

Tasks.Description: Design the SignUp page layout to include input fields for name, email, and password. Ensure that these fields are clearly labeled and accessible.
Implement front-end validation for the SignUp form to check the format of the email and the strength of the password before submission.
Develop a backend service to handle SignUp form submissions. This service should check if the email already exists in the database and respond accordingly.
Encrypt passwords using a secure hashing algorithm like bcrypt before storing them in the database to ensure data security.
Set up an email service to send a confirmation email to the user once the registration successfully completes. This service should handle potential errors like email delivery failures.

Create a mechanism to display an error message on the SignUp page if the registration fails due to an existing email address. This should guide the user to try a different email or recover their forgotten password.
Ensure that all user inputs are sanitized on the server side to prevent SQL injection and other common security vulnerabilities.
Develop unit tests for the SignUp functionality to ensure that all acceptance criteria are met and the function behaves as expected under various scenarios.
Integrate the SignUp form with the website's front-end ensuring it aligns with the overall design and user experience standards set for the platform.
Conduct a security review of the SignUp process to ensure compliance with data protection regulations and best practices in cybersecurity.

E001.Epic Description: Develop secure and intuitive user account management functionalities including SignUp and SignIn, allowing users to register, access, and manage their accounts, thus driving user engagement and platform security.
E001.Story Description: As a returning user, I want to be able to sign in using my email and password so that I can access my account securely.
Story Acceptance Criteria: The SignIn page must authenticate users by their email and encrypted password.
Users are redirected to their profile page upon successful login.
An error message is displayed for incorrect login credentials.
Session timeout must be implemented for security.

Tasks.Description: Implement a secure authentication function in Python to validate user login credentials. This function should take email and password as inputs, verify the password against a hashed and salted version stored in the database, and return a boolean indicating successful or failed authentication.

Create a user session management system in Python that initializes a session upon successful login. Include session expiration functionality that logs the user out after a predefined period of inactivity. The session should contain the user's unique session ID and timestamp of the last activity.

Design and implement a user redirection mechanism in Python after successful login to direct users to their profile page. The function should check the authentication status and navigate the user accordingly.

Develop an error handling mechanism in Python for login failures. The function should include validation checks for user input and display appropriate error messages for scenarios such as incorrect password or non-existent email address without specifying which part of the credential is incorrect.

E001.Epic Description: Develop secure and intuitive user account management functionalities including SignUp and SignIn, allowing users to register, access, and manage their accounts, thus driving user engagement and platform security.
E001.Story Description: As a logged-in user, I want to be able to edit my profile details so that I can keep my personal information up to date.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Logged-in users can access an Edit Profile page with pre-populated fields of current information.
Users can update their name, email, and profile picture.
Changes are saved immediately upon user confirmation.
Users receive a confirmation notification upon successful update.

Tasks.Description: Design the user interface for the Edit Profile page ensuring it includes input fields for name, email, and profile picture, and a save button for submitting changes.
Implement front-end functionality using JavaScript to populate the Edit Profile form fields with the current user information retrieved from the database upon page load.
Develop the backend API endpoint for handling GET requests to fetch current user details from the database using user authentication for data security.

Create the backend API endpoint for handling POST requests to update user information (name, email, and profile picture) in the database. Ensure all inputs are validated against security standards before updating the database.
Implement input validation on the front end to check the correctness of email formats and ensure that the name field does not contain invalid characters.
Integrate functionality to upload and store the profile picture securely. Ensure images are stored in a secure location and that the image URLs are protected against unauthorized access.
Write unit tests for the backend API to ensure that both GET and POST operations behave as expected under various conditions including valid and invalid inputs.
Configure the server to send a confirmation notification to the user's email upon successful profile update, using a pre-designed email template that reflects the changes made.
Conduct integration tests to ensure that the front-end and back-end systems work seamlessly together, particularly focusing on data retrieval and update functionalities.
Perform security audits on the new profile editing feature to ensure that there are no vulnerabilities such as SQL injection possibilities or unauthorized access to user data.

Plan a user acceptance testing (UAT) session to gather feedback from real users about the usability and functionality of the Edit Profile feature, making adjustments based on the feedback before final deployment.
Prepare deployment scripts and migration plans to seamlessly integrate the new Edit Profile functionality into the existing platform without affecting the current user experience.

Update user documentation and help sections on the website to include instructions on how to use the new Edit Profile features, highlighting the ability to update the profile picture and the importance of keeping personal information current.

E001.Epic Description: Develop secure and intuitive user account management functionalities including SignUp and SignIn, allowing users to register, access, and manage their accounts, thus driving user engagement and platform security.
E001.Story Description: As a logged-in user, I want to create and manage a wishlist so that I can save items or services I am interested in for future reference.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Logged-in users can access a 'Create Wishlist' feature from their profile.
Users can add items to their wishlist and remove them as needed.
The wishlist must update in real-time as items are added or removed.
Users can view their complete wishlist at any time.

Tasks.Description: Design a UI component for the 'Create Wishlist' feature that can be accessed from the user's profile page. This should include a button or link clearly labeled to allow users to initiate the creation of a new wishlist.

Implement backend API to support the creation of a new wishlist. This API should handle POST requests containing the new wishlist's name and optional description, and return success or error messages accordingly.

Develop the functionality to add items to the wishlist. This requires a form within the 'Create Wishlist' UI where users can input item details, and a backend service to process this information and update the database.
Create a dynamic UI component that allows users to view their wishlist in real-time. This component should update automatically as items are added or removed without requiring a page refresh.
Implement backend logic to handle real-time updates to the wishlist. This involves setting up WebSocket or similar technology to push updates to the client whenever changes occur in the database.
Setup a database schema for storing wishlists and their items. This should include appropriate fields for item details, user association, and timestamps for creation and updates.

Develop the functionality to remove items from the wishlist. This should include a method in the UI for users to delete items and backend support to handle the removal and update the user's view dynamically.
Ensure that the 'Create Wishlist' feature is only accessible to logged-in users by implementing appropriate authentication checks in the front-end and back-end systems.
Implement comprehensive unit and integration tests to validate the functionality of the wishlist creation, item addition, item removal, and real-time updates.
Set up monitoring and logging for the wishlist management features to capture usage metrics and errors, which will help in maintaining the system's health and troubleshooting issues.
Plan a user acceptance testing phase to gather feedback on the usability and functionality of the wishlist feature from a group of end-users prior to full deployment.

E001.Epic Description: Develop secure and intuitive user account management functionalities including SignUp and SignIn, allowing users to register, access, and manage their accounts, thus driving user engagement and platform security.
E001.Story Description: As a user, I want to be able to navigate easily from the landing page to SignUp, SignIn, and other functionalities so that I can utilize the application smoothly.
Story Acceptance Criteria: The landing page must clearly display options for SignUp and SignIn.
Links to 'Edit Profile' and 'Create Wishlist' should be accessible post-login.
The landing page should load within 3 seconds to ensure a quick access time.
The design should be responsive for accessibility across devices.

Tasks.Description: Design a prototype of the landing page with clear, prominently displayed options for SignUp and SignIn, ensuring that these elements are easily visible and accessible.

Implement a responsive web design for the landing page that adjusts the layout and content dynamically based on the device used (desktop, tablet, mobile) to maintain usability and aesthetic appeal across different devices.

Develop the functionality to ensure that once users log in, they can access links to 'Edit Profile' and 'Create Wishlist' directly from the landing page. These links should be conditionally rendered only after a successful login.

Optimize the landing page load time to ensure it loads within 3 seconds by minimizing the size of images, implementing efficient code practices, and using content delivery network (CDN) services for static assets.

Conduct cross-browser and cross-device testing to ensure the landing page displays correctly and functions properly across a variety of platforms and devices, addressing any compatibility issues found during testing.

Set up a monitoring system to continuously track the loading time of the landing page and alert the development team if the load time exceeds 3 seconds, enabling quick identification and resolution of performance issues.

Develop and integrate a dynamic frontend framework that allows for the interactive elements of the landing page, such as SignUp and SignIn forms, to function smoothly without page reloads, enhancing the user experience.

Ensure that all web page elements adhere to accessibility standards (WCAG) to provide equal access and equal opportunity to people with disabilities, including keyboard navigability and screen reader support.

E001.Epic Description: Develop secure and intuitive user account management functionalities including SignUp and SignIn, allowing users to register, access, and manage their accounts, thus driving user engagement and platform security.
E001.Story Description: As a Business Owner, I want all user data to be handled securely in compliance with relevant laws and regulations to protect the business from legal issues and to maintain user trust.
Story Acceptance Criteria: All data transmission must be secured using HTTPS.
Compliance with GDPR and other relevant privacy laws must be ensured.
Regular security audits are conducted to identify and rectify vulnerabilities.
Encryption standards like AES or bcrypt are used for storing sensitive user data.

Tasks.Description: Implement HTTPS for all data transmissions: Ensure that all data sent and received by the web application is transmitted over HTTPS. This includes setting up SSL/TLS certificates and configuring web servers to default to HTTPS connections.

Compliance audit for GDPR and privacy laws: Schedule and conduct an audit to assess the application's compliance with GDPR and other relevant privacy laws. This task involves reviewing current data handling practices, privacy policies, and compliance measures in place.

Develop a GDPR compliance plan: Based on the audit findings, create a detailed action plan to address any compliance gaps. This should include implementing necessary changes to user consent protocols, data access procedures, and privacy notices.

Implement regular security audits: Establish a routine for conducting security audits, including the frequency and scope of the audits. This task also involves selecting and coordinating with an external security firm to perform these audits.

Review and update security audit procedures: After each audit, review the findings and update security measures and protocols accordingly. Ensure that any vulnerabilities identified are addressed promptly.

Implement data encryption using AES or bcrypt: Encrypt all sensitive user data stored in the database using advanced encryption standards such as AES or bcrypt. This includes user passwords, personal information, and any other data classified as sensitive.

Document encryption practices: Create comprehensive documentation on the encryption methods used, including guidelines for developers on how to implement and manage these encryption standards in the application.

Training on data security for the development team: Organize training sessions for the development team on best practices for data security, focusing on secure coding practices, data encryption, and compliance with privacy laws.

E002.Epic Description: Create functionalities for users to edit and update their profiles post-registration, enabling personalized user experiences which can improve user satisfaction and retention.
E002.Story Description: As a registered user, I want to update my profile information, so that I can keep my personal data up-to-date.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Users can access their profile via a secure login.
Users can edit fields such as name, email, and profile picture.
Changes must be saved and immediately visible upon the user session refresh.
There should be a confirmation message after successful update.
The system should handle errors and provide meaningful messages if updates fail.

Tasks.Description: Implement secure login functionality to ensure that users can access their profile information safely. Use SSL/TLS for secure data transmission and hash passwords for secure storage.
Develop a user profile page that allows users to view and edit fields such as name, email, and profile picture. Ensure fields are pre-populated with existing user data retrieved from the database.
Create a backend service to handle profile updates. This service should update the user's information in the database and ensure changes are immediately visible on the user session refresh.
Implement a confirmation mechanism that triggers a message to the user interface confirming successful updates. This message could be a simple popup or a temporary banner on the profile page.

Design error handling logic that captures and logs errors occurring during the profile update process. Errors should trigger meaningful messages to the user to explain what went wrong, like 'Unable to update profile, please try again later.'

E002.Epic Description: Create functionalities for users to edit and update their profiles post-registration, enabling personalized user experiences which can improve user satisfaction and retention.
E002.Story Description: As a registered user, I want to customize additional elements of my profile, such as a custom username and a bio, so that I can personalize my user experience on the platform.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Users can edit customizable fields like username and bio from their profile settings.
The changes should be immediately reflected in the user's profile view to others.
Input fields should have validation to prevent inappropriate content.
Provide tooltips or helper text to guide users through the customization options.

Tasks.Description: Design and implement an edit form on the user profile page that includes fields for username and bio. Ensure the form adheres to the platform's UI/UX standards.
Add backend support for updating username and bio fields. This includes modifying the database schema if necessary, and ensuring that the API supports updating these new fields.

Implement input validation for the username and bio fields to ensure data integrity. This should include checks for appropriate content (e.g., no offensive language), length restrictions, and potentially prohibited special characters.
Develop a real-time update feature so that any changes in the username and bio are immediately visible on the user's profile view to others without the need to refresh the page.

Create tooltips or helper texts for the username and bio input fields. These should guide the user on the type of content allowed, any specific format requirements, and general tips to enhance their profile.
Conduct thorough testing to ensure that changes are reflected immediately, validations are correctly enforced, and the user experience is consistent across different device types.
Document the changes made to the system including the database schema updates, API changes, and any new front-end components. Update the system's technical documentation to reflect these changes.
Plan and execute a deployment strategy to roll out the new profile customization features to production, ensuring minimal downtime and disruption to existing users.

E002.Epic Description: Create functionalities for users to edit and update their profiles post-registration, enabling personalized user experiences which can improve user satisfaction and retention.
E002.Story Description: As a registered user, I want to manage my privacy settings, so that I can control the visibility of my profile information.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Users should have a section in their profile for privacy settings.
Options to make certain information public or private must be available (e.g., email, phone number).
Changes should take effect immediately.
System should confirm privacy settings updates with the user.

Tasks.Description: Design a user interface section within the profile settings where users can access and adjust their privacy settings. This interface should clearly list all available information fields (e.g., email, phone number) with toggles or dropdowns allowing users to select 'public' or 'private'.

Implement frontend functionality in Python using a framework such as Flask or Django to handle user interactions in the privacy settings section. This includes capturing user inputs for privacy preferences and sending these preferences to the server via secure API endpoints.

Develop API endpoints that receive privacy setting changes from the frontend. Ensure these endpoints authenticate requests to verify that they are coming from the user whose settings are being changed.

Create backend logic to update the user's privacy settings in the database based on the inputs received from the API endpoints. This logic must handle different types of data fields and their respective privacy settings.
Set up real-time update capabilities so that changes in privacy settings are applied immediately in the database and reflect in the user’s session without needing a page reload or re-login.

Implement a confirmation mechanism that notifies the user within the application once their privacy settings have been successfully updated. This could be a pop-up message or a temporary banner on the profile page.

E002.Epic Description: Create functionalities for users to edit and update their profiles post-registration, enabling personalized user experiences which can improve user satisfaction and retention.
E002.Story Description: As a business owner, I want the user profile data to be securely handled, so that user trust is maintained thereby increasing retention.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Profile edits and data transmission are secured via HTTPS.
Implement data encryption for sensitive user data stored in the database.
Regular security audits and compliance checks must be performed.
Users are notified of the privacy and security measures in place through the user interface.

Tasks.Description: Implement HTTPS for all data transmissions related to user profile management to ensure data is securely transmitted over the network.
Apply encryption techniques such as AES or bcrypt for storing sensitive user data like passwords and personal information in the database to ensure data at rest is secure.
Schedule regular security audits to check the robustness of the security implementations around user profile data handling and data transmission.
Develop a user-facing section within the profile settings where users can read and understand the security and privacy measures that have been implemented to protect their data.
Create detailed logging for all profile edit activities and data transmission events to facilitate audits and ensure compliance with data security policies.
Set up automated compliance checks that continuously monitor and validate the application’s adherence to data protection laws and regulations.
Design and implement user notifications within the application that alert users to changes in privacy policies, security enhancements, and any actions performed on their profiles.

E002.Epic Description: Create functionalities for users to edit and update their profiles post-registration, enabling personalized user experiences which can improve user satisfaction and retention.
E002.Story Description: As a business owner, I want to analyze user profile updates, so that I can understand user behavior and preferences to improve marketing strategies.
Story Acceptance Criteria: System should log all profile update activities.
Analytics dashboard should represent data through charts and graphs.
Data should be filterable by date, type of change, and user demographics.
Dashboard must be accessible only by authorized personnel.

Tasks.Description: Design and implement a logging mechanism to capture all profile update activities. Ensure that each log entry includes user identifier, type of update, timestamp, and the fields changed.

Develop an analytics dashboard backend to aggregate and process user profile update logs. Include capabilities to compute and store statistics such as frequency of updates, common fields updated, and trends over time.

Create a user interface for the analytics dashboard that displays data in charts and graphs. Utilize chart libraries like Chart.js or Google Charts to represent data visually concerning various user demographics and update types.
Implement filters in the analytics dashboard that allow users to view data based on date range, type of profile change, and user demographics such as age group, location, and gender.

Set up access control for the analytics dashboard to ensure it is accessible only by authorized personnel. Integrate with existing authentication systems to verify the credentials and roles of users attempting to access the dashboard.

E003.Epic Description: Implement a feature for users to create and manage personalized wishlists, enhancing user interaction and engagement with the platform, which can lead to increased user retention and satisfaction.
E003.Story Description: As a user, I want to create a personalized wishlist so that I can save items I am interested in for future reference or purchase.
Story Acceptance Criteria: User must be logged in to access the wishlist creation feature.
User should be able to add items to the wishlist from the product catalog.
User should be able to name the wishlist and provide a description.
The system must save the wishlist persistently so that it can be accessed in future sessions.
The system should provide a confirmation message once the wishlist is created.

Tasks.Description: Create an authentication function to verify if a user is logged in before allowing access to the wishlist creation feature. Inputs: User session data. Outputs: Boolean indicating authentication status.

Develop a UI form for creating a new wishlist that includes fields for the wishlist name, a description, and an option to add items from the product catalog. Inputs: User inputs for name, description, and selected items. Outputs: Data structure containing the new wishlist details.

Implement a backend service to handle the addition of items to a wishlist. The service should pull item details from the product catalog and append them to the user's wishlist. Inputs: Item IDs from the product catalog, User ID. Outputs: Updated wishlist with new items.

Create a persistent storage solution for wishlists that allows wishlists to be saved and retrieved across different sessions. Inputs: Wishlist data including name, description, items, and user ID. Outputs: Confirmation of storage with a unique wishlist ID.

Implement a confirmation mechanism that triggers a message to the user interface once a wishlist is successfully created. Inputs: Success status from the wishlist creation process. Outputs: User-facing confirmation message about the creation status.

E003.Epic Description: Implement a feature for users to create and manage personalized wishlists, enhancing user interaction and engagement with the platform, which can lead to increased user retention and satisfaction.
E003.Story Description: As a user, I want to manage my existing wishlists so that I can update items, rename, or delete my wishlist as needed.
Story Acceptance Criteria: User must be logged in to modify a wishlist.
User should be able to add or remove items from the wishlist.
User should be able to rename the wishlist and change its description.
User should be able to delete a wishlist with a confirmation prompt to prevent accidental deletions.
Changes to the wishlist should be updated in real-time and stored persistently.

Tasks.Description: Implement user authentication to verify that only logged-in users can access the wishlist modification features. This includes checks within the function to ensure a user session is active before allowing access to modify a wishlist.

Develop a function to add items to a user's wishlist. The function should accept inputs such as user ID, wishlist ID, and item details (name, description, etc.). This function will append the new item to the existing wishlist in the database.

Create a function to remove items from a user's wishlist. Inputs will include user ID, wishlist ID, and item ID. The function should locate the item within the specified wishlist and remove it, updating the wishlist record in the database.

Construct functionality allowing users to rename their wishlist or change its description. This requires inputs of user ID, wishlist ID, and new values for the wishlist's name and/or description. The function must update these fields in the database and confirm the changes were made.

Implement a deletion feature for wishlists that includes a confirmation step to prevent accidental deletions. This will require user ID, wishlist ID, and a confirmation flag as inputs. Upon confirmation, the function should remove the wishlist from the database.

Ensure that all modifications (additions, deletions, renames, description changes) to the wishlist are reflected in real-time and stored persistently. This involves setting up database triggers or function calls within the wishlist management system to refresh and update the user's view immediately after any change.

E003.Epic Description: Implement a feature for users to create and manage personalized wishlists, enhancing user interaction and engagement with the platform, which can lead to increased user retention and satisfaction.
E003.Story Description: As a user, I want to share my wishlist with friends or family so that they can view the items I've saved.
Story Acceptance Criteria: User must be logged in to share a wishlist.
The system should generate a shareable link that the user can send to others.
Recipients of the link should be able to view the wishlist without needing to log in.
The shareable link should be secure and should not allow unauthorized editing of the wishlist.
The system should provide an option to revoke the shared link.

Tasks.Description: Implement a user authentication check to ensure that a user must be logged in before they can share a wishlist. This involves modifying the wishlist sharing function to verify user authentication status before proceeding.
Develop functionality to generate a unique, shareable link for each wishlist. This includes creating a secure method for generating the link and ensuring that it is unique to each wishlist instance.

Create a view-only interface for the wishlist that can be accessed via the shareable link. This interface should not require login and should restrict any editing capabilities, providing only the capability to view the wishlist contents.

Ensure the security of the shareable link by implementing measures such as token-based validation to prevent unauthorized access and editing of the wishlist. Include methods to verify the integrity and origin of the link when accessed.

Develop a feature that allows users to revoke or invalidate the shareable link. This involves adding a mechanism in the user interface for the link creator to manage or cancel the shared link and updating the backend to handle the revocation process.

E003.Epic Description: Implement a feature for users to create and manage personalized wishlists, enhancing user interaction and engagement with the platform, which can lead to increased user retention and satisfaction.
E003.Story Description: As a user, I want to set visibility options for my wishlists so that I can control who can see my wishlists.
Story Acceptance Criteria: User must be logged in to set wishlist visibility.
User should be able to set the wishlist as public, private, or visible only to specific people.
If set to specific people, the system should allow users to select friends or enter email addresses to grant access.
Changes to visibility settings should be applied immediately and persistently saved.
The system should ensure that privacy settings are respected in all views and shared links.

Tasks.Description: Implement user authentication check to verify that a user is logged in before allowing access to the wishlist visibility settings feature.
Create a user interface component on the wishlist management page that allows the user to toggle wishlist visibility between public, private, or specific people.
Develop backend logic to support storing and retrieving the visibility state of a wishlist in the database, ensuring changes are immediately and persistently saved.

Implement functionality in the backend to allow users to select friends or enter email addresses for granting access to the wishlist when the visibility is set to specific people. This includes integrating with a user friend list or directory if available.

Ensure that the system respects the privacy settings in all views where the wishlist might appear, including shared links, by implementing appropriate access control checks in the wishlist retrieval logic.

Create automated tests to verify that the wishlist visibility settings work as expected, including checks for immediate application of settings, persistence after logout, and proper access control in shared views.

Update user documentation and help sections to include instructions on how to use the new wishlist visibility settings, emphasizing the options to set visibility to public, private, or specific people.

E003.Epic Description: Implement a feature for users to create and manage personalized wishlists, enhancing user interaction and engagement with the platform, which can lead to increased user retention and satisfaction.
E003.Story Title: User Story: Business Analytics for Wishlists
E003.Story Description: As a business owner, I want to access analytics on user wishlists so that I can understand customer preferences and plan my inventory accordingly.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Business owners must have administrative access to view analytics.
Analytics should include data on the most added items, frequently shared wishlists, and user engagement with wishlists.
The system should provide options to filter analytics by date range, product category, and user demographics.
Data should be presented in a clear, visual format such as graphs and charts.
The analytics feature should comply with privacy regulations, ensuring that user-specific data is anonymized.

Tasks.Description: Implement secure administrative access control functionality to restrict analytics view to business owners only. Ensure authentication mechanisms are in place to verify the identity and role of the user accessing the analytics.

Develop a backend function to aggregate and calculate data on the most added items, frequently shared wishlists, and overall user engagement with wishlists. This function should process data from the database and prepare it for analytics presentation.

Create a feature on the analytics dashboard that allows users to filter the aggregated data by date range, product category, and user demographics. This involves implementing UI components for date pickers, dropdowns for categories, and demographics options.

Design a data visualization component that integrates with the analytics dashboard to display the aggregated data in graphs and charts. Utilize libraries such as D3.js or Chart.js for rendering visual analytics.

Ensure compliance with privacy regulations by implementing data anonymization techniques before data is processed for analytics. This includes masking or removing personally identifiable information (PII) from the datasets used in analytics.

E004.Epic Description: Design and implement an inviting and informative landing page that directs users efficiently to either sign up, sign in, or access their profiles and wishlists, thereby increasing conversion rates and enhancing user experience.
E004.Story Description: As a Business Owner, I want the landing page to have a visually appealing and clear design that highlights the SignUp, SignIn, Edit Profile, and Create Wishlist features, so that new and returning users are encouraged to interact with the site, leading to higher engagement and conversion rates.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Landing page must include visible call-to-action buttons for SignUp and SignIn.
Include separate links or buttons for returning users to access their profiles and wishlists directly.
Design must be responsive to work across various devices and screen sizes.
Landing page loads within 3 seconds to ensure quick access.

Tasks.Description: Design a prototype for the landing page that includes prominently visible call-to-action buttons for SignUp and SignIn.
Implement separate links or buttons on the landing page that enable returning users to directly access their profiles and wishlists.
Ensure the landing page design is responsive, testing across multiple device types including desktops, tablets, and smartphones to confirm usability and visual appeal on all screen sizes.

Optimize front-end assets such as images, scripts, and CSS files to ensure the landing page loads within 3 seconds. Use techniques like compression, minification, and efficient content delivery network (CDN) utilization.
Conduct cross-browser compatibility testing to ensure that the landing page renders correctly and functions across different web browsers.
Set up a web performance monitoring tool to continually track the loading speed of the landing page and identify any performance bottlenecks.

Implement accessibility features on the landing page to adhere to WCAG (Web Content Accessibility Guidelines) ensuring that all users, including those with disabilities, can navigate and interact with the page effectively.
Develop unit tests for new front-end code to ensure that all elements on the landing page function as expected and meet the design specifications.
Schedule a review session with stakeholders to gather feedback on the prototype and make necessary adjustments based on the feedback.
Prepare and maintain documentation detailing the design and functionality of the landing page for future reference and ongoing maintenance.

E004.Epic Description: Design and implement an inviting and informative landing page that directs users efficiently to either sign up, sign in, or access their profiles and wishlists, thereby increasing conversion rates and enhancing user experience.
E004.Story Description: As a Business Owner, I want the website to offer an easy and secure SignUp process on the landing page, so that new users can effortlessly create accounts, thereby increasing user growth and expanding the customer base.
Story Acceptance Criteria: SignUp form is accessible from the main landing page.
Form includes fields for name, email, and password.
All data entries must be validated for format and completeness before submission.
Submission of the signup form leads to a verification email being sent to the user’s provided email address.

Tasks.Description: Design a SignUp form component that includes fields for name, email, and password. The design should be user-friendly and clearly label each field while adhering to accessibility standards.
Integrate the SignUp form on the main landing page ensuring it is prominently placed for easy access by new users. Use responsive design practices to ensure the form is accessible on various devices.

Implement front-end validation for the SignUp form to check the format and completeness of the data input in the name, email, and password fields. Use regex for email validation and minimum criteria for password strength.
Develop a backend API endpoint to handle SignUp form submissions. This endpoint should accept name, email, and password, and check for the uniqueness of the email address in the database.
Implement password hashing on the server side before storing the user's password in the database to ensure security.
Create functionality to send a verification email to the user’s provided email address upon successful submission of the SignUp form. Use an email service provider that ensures reliable delivery.
Set up unit tests for both front-end and back-end validations to ensure the SignUp process works as expected under various scenarios.
Conduct cross-browser and device testing for the SignUp form to ensure compatibility and responsiveness across different platforms.
Prepare user documentation that explains how to use the SignUp form, including details on the information required and the verification process.

Implement analytics to track user interaction with the SignUp form, including form completion rates and common points of user drop-off, to understand user behavior and improve the form based on data insights.

E004.Epic Description: Design and implement an inviting and informative landing page that directs users efficiently to either sign up, sign in, or access their profiles and wishlists, thereby increasing conversion rates and enhancing user experience.
E004.Story Description: As a Business Owner, I want the website to enable a secure SignIn option on the landing page, so that returning users can easily access their profiles and wishlists, promoting frequent user engagement.
Story Acceptance Criteria: SignIn form is accessible from the main landing page.
Includes fields for email and password.
Must include a 'Forgot password?' link.
Correct credentials allow access to the user's dashboard.
Invalid login attempts provide a clear error message without revealing which element (email or password) was incorrect.

Tasks.Description: Design a SignIn form interface including fields for email and password, and a 'Forgot password?' link. Ensure the form is directly accessible from the main landing page.
