Add options on the UI to save any changes made to the wishlist or to clear the wishlist completely. Ensure these actions are clear to the user and include confirmations to prevent accidental data loss.
Implement robust error handling and user feedback mechanisms. This should include loading indicators during network requests and informative messages for actions like saving changes or errors.
Ensure compliance with web accessibility standards to make the wishlist creation and modification features usable for all users, including those with disabilities.
Conduct thorough testing of the wishlist functionality, including unit tests for backend services and UI tests to ensure features work as expected across different browsers and devices.
Prepare documentation for the wishlist feature that includes details on how to use the feature, any necessary configurations, and troubleshooting common issues.

E001.Epic Description: Develop a robust user management system to handle SignUp, SignIn, and user authentication processes, ensuring secure access controls and management capabilities for administrators.
E001.Story Description: As a System Administrator, I want to access a dedicated admin dashboard so that I can manage all user accounts and their activities.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Admin login credentials must be validated securely.
The dashboard must display user account status, recent activity, and management options.
The dashboard must be accessible only to users with administrator privileges.

Tasks.Description: Implement secure login functionality for the admin dashboard using multi-factor authentication to ensure that admin credentials are validated securely.
Develop the front-end of the admin dashboard to display information such as user account status, recent activities, and management options. Ensure the design is clear and user-friendly.
Integrate backend services to fetch real-time data regarding user account status and activities, ensuring that the data displayed is up-to-date and accurate.

Set up role-based access control in the admin dashboard to ensure that it is accessible only to users with administrator privileges. This includes configuring the server to recognize and authorize different levels of user roles.

Conduct thorough testing of the admin dashboard to validate functionality, security of login credentials, data accuracy, and proper access control. Include unit tests, integration tests, and user acceptance testing.

Document the admin dashboard functionality, including details on secure login processes, data presented, and how to manage user accounts. Ensure the documentation is clear and accessible for future reference and training.

E001.Epic Description: Develop a robust user management system to handle SignUp, SignIn, and user authentication processes, ensuring secure access controls and management capabilities for administrators.
E001.Story Description: As a System Administrator, I want to have the ability to activate, deactivate, or delete user accounts so that I can ensure proper access control and compliance with our policies.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Options to activate, deactivate, or delete accounts must be clearly accessible in the admin dashboard.
Changes made by the administrator should be reflected immediately in the system.
All changes must be logged for audit purposes.

Tasks.Description: Design and implement an Admin Dashboard interface that includes clearly labeled buttons or controls for activating, deactivating, and deleting user accounts.
Develop backend API endpoints to handle activation, deactivation, and deletion requests for user accounts. These endpoints should update the account status immediately in the database.
Ensure that the front-end Admin Dashboard communicates with these backend API endpoints to perform account status updates in real-time.

Create a logging system that captures all changes made by administrators regarding user account status. Include details such as the admin's user ID, the affected account's user ID, the type of change (activate, deactivate, delete), and the timestamp.
Integrate the logging system with the backend API endpoints so that every change triggers a new log entry.
Implement a review mechanism in the Admin Dashboard where administrators can search, view, and filter the change logs.
Conduct unit testing for each API endpoint to ensure they handle account activations, deactivations, and deletions correctly.
Perform integration testing to verify that the Admin Dashboard works seamlessly with the backend API and logging system for managing user account statuses.
Develop role-based access control to ensure only authorized administrators can activate, deactivate, or delete user accounts.
Create user documentation that explains how to use the new functionalities in the Admin Dashboard.

E001.Epic Description: Develop a robust user management system to handle SignUp, SignIn, and user authentication processes, ensuring secure access controls and management capabilities for administrators.
E001.Story Description: As a System Administrator, I want to assign roles to users and modify them as necessary so that users have appropriate access to system functionalities.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Administrators should be able to assign, modify, or revoke roles through the admin dashboard.
The system must enforce access restrictions based on user roles.
Any role changes should be updated in real-time and logged for auditing.

Tasks.Description: Design and implement a user interface on the admin dashboard for role management that allows administrators to assign, modify, or revoke roles for users. Include options to select users and assign predefined roles or custom roles as required.
Develop backend functionality to handle role assignment requests from the admin dashboard. This should include methods to update the user's role in the database securely and efficiently.

Implement role-based access control (RBAC) middleware in the system's backend that intercepts requests and checks if the authenticated user's role matches the role requirements of the requested resource or operation.
Create a real-time update system using WebSocket or similar technology to ensure that any changes in user roles are immediately reflected on the admin dashboard without requiring a page refresh.

Set up a logging system to record all role assignment changes. Logs should capture who made the change, the timestamp of the change, the affected user, and details of the role change (assigned, modified, revoked).
Implement unit tests to verify that role assignment, modification, and revocation work as expected across different scenarios and edge cases.
Conduct integration testing to ensure that the role-based access control system correctly restricts or allows access based on the user's role and that updates are reflected in real-time.

Deploy the new role management functionalities to a staging environment for acceptance testing by the system administrators to ensure the solution meets the specified requirements and is user-friendly.
Prepare documentation for system administrators that outlines how to use the new role management features, including assigning, modifying, and revoking roles from the admin dashboard.

E001.Epic Description: Develop a robust user management system to handle SignUp, SignIn, and user authentication processes, ensuring secure access controls and management capabilities for administrators.
E001.Story Description: As a System Administrator, I want to view and export audit logs so that I can monitor changes and access patterns to ensure security compliance.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Audit logs must capture all user activities including logins, role changes, and profile updates.
Logs must be viewable through the admin dashboard and exportable in common file formats.
Logs should be stored securely and retain data according to compliance requirements.

Tasks.Description: Design and implement a database schema for storing audit logs. The schema should include fields for user ID, activity type (e.g., login, role change, profile update), timestamp, and additional details pertinent to the activity.

Develop a logging mechanism that captures all user activities specified in the acceptance criteria (logins, role changes, profile updates). This mechanism should be integrated into the existing user management system to record activities as they occur.

Create an admin dashboard interface that can display audit logs. This interface should allow administrators to search, filter, and view logs based on different criteria such as date, user ID, and activity type.

Implement a feature in the admin dashboard to export audit logs. Support common file formats like CSV, PDF, and Excel. Ensure the export functionality includes options to select specific time ranges and activity types.
Ensure all audit log data is encrypted and stored securely to prevent unauthorized access. Implement security measures such as access controls and encryption to protect the stored data.

Set up a data retention policy for the audit logs to ensure they are retained according to compliance requirements. Implement functionalities to automatically purge logs that exceed the retention period.

E001.Epic Description: Develop a robust user management system to handle SignUp, SignIn, and user authentication processes, ensuring secure access controls and management capabilities for administrators.
E001.Story Description: As a System Administrator, I want to enable two-factor authentication for administrative accounts to enhance the security of sensitive operations.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Two-factor authentication must be configurable through the admin dashboard.
Once enabled, it should require a secondary verification method (e.g., SMS, email, authenticator app) in addition to the password.
There should be support for backup codes in case the primary two-factor method is unavailable.

Tasks.Description: Design the user interface for the two-factor authentication configuration section in the admin dashboard. This includes options to enable/disable TFA, select the secondary verification methods, and generate backup codes.
Implement the backend functionality to support enabling and configuring two-factor authentication. This includes database changes to store user TFA settings and backup codes securely.
Integrate a third-party service (e.g., Twilio for SMS, SendGrid for email) to send the secondary verification method during the login process.
Develop functionality in the backend to handle the two-factor authentication flow during login, including verifying the secondary method and handling fallback to backup codes.
Create a system to generate, store, and validate backup codes. These codes should be hashed and securely stored in the database similar to passwords.
Implement front-end logic for admins to manage their two-factor authentication settings, including setting up and viewing backup codes, and switching secondary verification methods.

Conduct security testing to ensure that the two-factor authentication process is secure, including the generation and validation of backup codes and the integration with third-party verification services.
Prepare documentation for the system administrators on how to configure and use the two-factor authentication system, including troubleshooting common issues.
Develop a user-friendly error-handling strategy for failures in the two-factor authentication process, such as failed secondary verification or when backup codes are unavailable or incorrect.
Plan and perform a deployment strategy for the new two-factor authentication features, ensuring minimal disruption to existing functionalities.

E001.Epic Description: Develop a robust user management system to handle SignUp, SignIn, and user authentication processes, ensuring secure access controls and management capabilities for administrators.
E001.Story Description: As a System Administrator, I want to receive real-time notifications for critical user actions such as failed login attempts or role changes so that I can respond promptly to potential security incidents.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Notifications must be configurable in terms of types of actions that trigger alerts.
Notifications should be delivered via email and/or SMS to the administrator.
Each notification should provide sufficient details about the action to enable quick assessment and response.

Tasks.Description: Design a configuration interface in the admin dashboard that allows administrators to select and customize the user actions that will trigger real-time notifications. This interface should provide options for various user activities such as failed login attempts, successful logins, role changes, or profile updates.

Implement a backend service that monitors user activities defined in the notification settings. This service should check for specified activities and trigger the configured notifications when those activities occur.

Develop an email notification system integrated with the backend service to send real-time alerts to the administrator. This system should be capable of formatting email messages that include details of the user action, such as user ID, timestamp, and the nature of the action.

Integrate SMS notification capabilities using an SMS gateway API to send alerts directly to the administrator's mobile phone. The system must handle the configuration of API keys and phone numbers securely.

Create a detailed logging mechanism for the notification system to record each notification sent. This log should include the type of notification, the recipient, the time sent, and the triggering user action.
Conduct a security assessment to ensure that the notification system securely handles and transmits sensitive information, adhering to best practices for data protection and privacy.

Prepare and maintain documentation for the configuration and use of the notification system within the admin dashboard. This documentation should include steps on how to set up, modify, and troubleshoot notifications.

Implement automated tests to verify that the notification system works as expected under different scenarios such as multiple simultaneous actions, delayed network responses, and during system maintenance windows.

E002.Epic Description: Implement a system that allows administrators to manage and oversee user profile information, including the ability to edit, update, or remove user profiles as necessary.
E002.Story Description: As a System Administrator, I want to have the ability to access and view all user profiles so that I can oversee and manage user information effectively.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Admin can log into a secure admin panel.
Admin can view a list of all registered user profiles.
Admin can select any user profile to view detailed information.
Ensure security and confidentiality of user data during access.

Tasks.Description: Implement a secure login system for the admin panel. This system should authenticate administrators using a combination of username and password, and optionally, implement multi-factor authentication for enhanced security.

Develop the backend functionality to retrieve and list all registered user profiles. This includes creating a database query that can pull all necessary user information in a secure and efficient manner.

Create a user interface for the admin panel that displays a list of all user profiles. This interface should be clear and user-friendly, and allow administrators to browse through or search for specific user profiles easily.

Implement functionality that allows an admin to select and view detailed information on any user profile from the list. This should include pulling detailed data from the database and displaying it in the admin panel securely.

Ensure the security and confidentiality of user data by implementing data access controls and encryption. Only authorized administrators should be able to access user profile information, and sensitive data should be encrypted both in transit and at rest.

E002.Epic Description: Implement a system that allows administrators to manage and oversee user profile information, including the ability to edit, update, or remove user profiles as necessary.
E002.Story Description: As a System Administrator, I want the capability to edit user profiles so that I can update information on behalf of users when necessary.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Admin can select a user profile and edit fields such as name, email, etc.
Changes are saved and immediately reflected in the user's profile.
Admin receives a confirmation notification upon successful update.
User receives a notification that their profile has been updated by an administrator.

Tasks.Description: Design and implement a user interface in the admin dashboard for viewing and selecting user profiles. This interface should list all user profiles with options to select any profile for editing.

Develop backend API endpoints to fetch user profile data and support editing operations such as updating name, email, and other fields as required. Ensure the API uses secure methods for data handling and authentication to prevent unauthorized access.
Create a form on the admin dashboard for editing selected user profiles. The form should pre-populate with the current user's information and allow editable fields like name and email.
Implement functionality in the backend to save changes made to the user profile through the admin's edit form. This includes updating the database with new user details and ensuring data integrity.

Set up a notification system to send confirmation messages to both the admin and the user upon successful profile updates. Admins receive a backend-generated notification on the dashboard, and users receive an email notification.
Ensure all changes to user profiles are logged for auditing purposes. Include details such as the type of change, admin ID who made the change, and timestamp in the logs.

Conduct thorough testing of the new admin capabilities to edit user profiles. This includes unit tests for API endpoints, integration tests for the interaction between the frontend and backend, and user acceptance testing to ensure the feature meets all acceptance criteria.

Document the newly developed features, including a user guide for system administrators on how to use the profile editing functionality and technical documentation describing the API endpoints and data handling procedures.

E002.Epic Description: Implement a system that allows administrators to manage and oversee user profile information, including the ability to edit, update, or remove user profiles as necessary.
E002.Story Description: As a System Administrator, I want the ability to disable user accounts so that I can restrict access when users violate terms of service.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Admin can select a user profile and disable the user’s account.
Disabled accounts cannot log in or access the application.
Admin receives a confirmation notification upon successful account disabling.
User receives an email notification about their account status change.

Tasks.Description: Create a user interface component in the admin dashboard for searching and selecting user profiles. This component should include a search bar and a list view to display search results, allowing administrators to easily locate and select a user's profile.
Develop a backend API endpoint that supports disabling a user account. The endpoint should accept a user ID as a parameter and modify the account's status to 'disabled' in the database.

Implement frontend functionality on the admin dashboard to interact with the backend endpoint for disabling user accounts. Include a 'Disable Account' button in the user profile view, which when clicked, sends a request to the backend to disable the user's account.
Enhance the system to prevent login for disabled accounts. Modify the login validation process to check the account status and deny access if the account is disabled.

Design and implement a confirmation message on the admin dashboard to notify the administrator when an account has been successfully disabled. This message should be clear and indicate the success of the operation.

Set up an automated email notification system that triggers when an account is disabled. The system should send an email to the user's registered email address, informing them of the account status change.

E002.Epic Description: Implement a system that allows administrators to manage and oversee user profile information, including the ability to edit, update, or remove user profiles as necessary.
E002.Story Description: As a System Administrator, I want the option to delete user profiles so that I can remove users who no longer wish to use our platform or have requested account deletion.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Admin can permanently delete a user's profile from the database.
Ensure that all data related to the user is completely removed.
Admin receives a confirmation notification upon successful deletion.
Ensure compliance with data protection regulations concerning user data deletion.

Tasks.Description: Design and implement a backend function to handle the deletion of user profiles. The function should accept user ID as input and ensure that all associated data is removed from the database.

Create a confirmation mechanism that verifies with the administrator before permanently deleting any user data. This could be a confirmation dialog in the user interface that requires explicit admin action to proceed.
Develop a notification system that sends a confirmation notification to the administrator's dashboard and optionally via email upon successful deletion of a user profile.

Integrate compliance checks to ensure the deletion process adheres to data protection regulations such as GDPR. This includes logging the deletion event and anonymizing any retained data related to the deleted user profile.
Implement comprehensive unit tests to verify that the delete operation removes all data related to the user, handles errors appropriately, and sends notifications correctly.
Update the administrator documentation to include details on how to safely and compliantly delete user profiles, detailing the process and any legal considerations.

E002.Epic Description: Implement a system that allows administrators to manage and oversee user profile information, including the ability to edit, update, or remove user profiles as necessary.
E002.Story Description: As a System Administrator, I want to monitor and audit user activities so that I can ensure compliance with policy and detect any suspicious behavior.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Admin can view logs of user activities such as login times and changes made to profiles.
System maintains a secure and tamper-proof log of all user activities.
Admin can generate reports based on activity logs for audit and compliance purposes.

Tasks.Description: Design and implement a secure logging system integrated into all user activity areas within the application. This system should automatically record timestamps, user IDs, activity types, and specific changes made during each session.

Develop a centralized logging database designed to store logs securely. Ensure that the database is only accessible by authorized administrators and is protected against unauthorized access and tampering.

Create a user interface within the admin dashboard that allows administrators to view and search through the activity logs. Include filters to view logs by user, date, type of activity, and other relevant parameters.
Implement server-side validation to ensure that every entry logged is complete and accurate, enhancing the integrity of the logs maintained.

Develop a reporting module that allows administrators to generate customizable reports based on the logs. This module should support filtering by date ranges, user activities, login times, and other relevant data points.
Incorporate the ability to export these reports in various formats such as PDF, CSV, or HTML for audit and compliance purposes.
Ensure all logging and reporting functionalities are compliant with relevant data protection regulations and company policies. Implement regular checks and updates to maintain compliance.
Perform thorough testing of the logging and reporting system to ensure it works correctly across all user activities and admin functionalities.
Prepare documentation for the system administrators on how to use the new logging and reporting tools, including details on accessing, interpreting, and exporting the data.

E003.Epic Description: Create a module that enables administrators to manage user wishlists, including adding, editing, or deleting wishlist items, and to oversee how these lists are used and managed within the application.
E003.Story Description: As a System Administrator, I want the ability to view all user wishlists so that I can oversee the overall wishlist content and ensure it adheres to community guidelines.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Admin can view a list of all wishlists.
Admin can select any user's wishlist to view its details.
Admin can see the timestamp of the last update for each wishlist.
Ensure that the viewing interface is user-friendly and displays relevant information clearly.

Tasks.Description: Design a database schema to store wishlists, including fields for user ID, wishlist ID, item details, and timestamps for creation and last update.
Implement backend functionalities to fetch all wishlists from the database. This should include user ID association and relevant timestamp data.
Develop an API endpoint to retrieve wishlist data. This endpoint should handle requests authenticated as admin and return data in a structured format (e.g., JSON).
Create front-end functionality on the admin dashboard to display a list of all wishlists. Include user-friendly tables or lists that show wishlist details, linked to user IDs.

Implement a feature on the admin dashboard that allows admins to select and view details of any user's wishlist. This should include a detailed view mode that displays items, descriptions, and timestamps.
Ensure the admin interface for viewing wishlists has a user-friendly design, with clear labels, well-organized information, and responsive layout for different devices.
Conduct a UX/UI review of the wishlist management interface with a focus group of admins to gather feedback on usability and make necessary adjustments.
Integrate security measures to verify that only authenticated administrators can access the wishlist viewing functionalities.
Write unit tests for the API endpoint and backend functionalities to ensure data is retrieved correctly and only accessible by authenticated administrators.
Create system documentation that covers the new functionalities for viewing wishlists on the admin dashboard, including security protocols and user instructions.

E003.Epic Description: Create a module that enables administrators to manage user wishlists, including adding, editing, or deleting wishlist items, and to oversee how these lists are used and managed within the application.
E003.Story Description: As a System Administrator, I want the ability to add items to any user's wishlist so that I can assist in managing content when necessary.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Admin can select a user and add items to the user's wishlist.
The system should verify the admin's permissions before allowing the addition.
Admin must be able to search and select items to add using a search interface.
The system should confirm the addition with the admin and optionally notify the user.

Tasks.Description: Design and implement a user selection interface in the admin dashboard where administrators can search for and select users whose wishlists they want to manage.
Develop a permission check mechanism that verifies if the logged-in administrator has the appropriate rights to add items to a user's wishlist before enabling the functionality.

Create a search interface within the admin dashboard that allows administrators to search for items to add to the user's wishlist. This interface should include filters and search criteria to ease the item selection process.
Implement functionality to add selected items to the user's wishlist, including backend logic to update the database with new wishlist items.
Develop a confirmation mechanism that notifies the administrator upon successful addition of items to a wishlist. This should include a success message displayed in the admin dashboard.

Optionally, implement a feature to send notifications to users when an item is added to their wishlist by an administrator. This feature should include customizable templates for the notification messages.

E003.Epic Description: Create a module that enables administrators to manage user wishlists, including adding, editing, or deleting wishlist items, and to oversee how these lists are used and managed within the application.
E003.Story Description: As a System Administrator, I want the ability to edit items in any user's wishlist so that I can correct errors or update information as needed.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Admin can select an item in a user's wishlist and edit details.
The system should provide a form to change item details such as name, description, and quantity.
Changes must be saved immediately and accurately reflect in the system.
The system should log all changes made by the administrator for auditing purposes.

Tasks.Description: Design and implement a user interface form for administrators to select and edit wishlist items. The form should include input fields for item details such as name, description, and quantity.
Develop back-end functionality to fetch the current details of a selected wishlist item and populate the form fields when an item is selected for editing.
Implement input validation for the edit form to ensure that the data entered is in the correct format and meets defined constraints (e.g., non-empty strings, valid numbers).
Create API endpoints to handle the submission of edited item details. This endpoint should update the item details in the database upon receiving valid data from the administrator's edit form.
Ensure that changes to the wishlist items are immediately saved to the database and that the user interface reflects these changes in real-time without requiring a page refresh.

Implement logging of all changes made by administrators to wishlist items. Each log entry should include the administrator's identity, the date and time of the change, and the old and new values of the edited fields.
Conduct testing to verify that the edit functionality works as expected, that inputs are validated, and that the system correctly logs all changes. Include both unit tests and integration tests.
Create documentation for the new edit functionality, detailing how administrators can access and use the edit form, as well as describing the logging feature for auditing purposes.

E003.Epic Description: Create a module that enables administrators to manage user wishlists, including adding, editing, or deleting wishlist items, and to oversee how these lists are used and managed within the application.
E003.Story Description: As a System Administrator, I want the ability to delete items from any user's wishlist so that I can remove inappropriate or outdated items as necessary.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Admin can select an item in any user's wishlist and delete it.
The system should ask for confirmation before deleting the item.
Deleted items should be removed from the list instantly and no longer be retrievable.
The system should log the deletion and notify the user if configurated.

Tasks.Description: Design a user interface element on the admin dashboard that allows administrators to view detailed lists of all items in any user's wishlist. This interface should include selectable options or buttons for deletion next to each item.

Implement functionality that prompts a confirmation dialog when the 'delete' option is selected for an item in a wishlist. This dialog should require the administrator to confirm their intention to delete the item.

Develop the back-end logic to remove the selected item from the user's wishlist database immediately upon confirmation of deletion. Ensure that the deletion process is irreversible and that the item does not appear in the user interface post-deletion.

Create a system logging mechanism that records the details of the deletion action in the admin activity logs. This includes capturing the identity of the administrator, the timestamp of the deletion, and the details of the deleted item.
Implement an optional notification system that, if configured, sends an automated email or system notification to the user, informing them about the deletion of the item from their wishlist.

E003.Epic Description: Create a module that enables administrators to manage user wishlists, including adding, editing, or deleting wishlist items, and to oversee how these lists are used and managed within the application.
E003.Story Description: As a System Administrator, I want to view a history of all changes made to wishlists so that I can monitor activity and revert any inappropriate modifications.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Admin must be able to access a log of all edits, additions, and deletions made to wishlists.
The log should include details such as the type of change, who made the change, and the time of the change.
Admin should have the ability to filter the log by user, date, and type of change.
The system should allow admins to revert changes directly from the audit log.

Tasks.Description: Design and implement a database schema to log all wishlist changes. Include fields for change type (edit, add, delete), user ID of the changer, timestamp of the change, and details of the change.

Develop a backend service for capturing and storing every change made to wishlists in the newly designed database schema. Ensure that this service is triggered whenever a wishlist is edited, an item is added, or an item is deleted.
Create an API endpoint to fetch the wishlist change logs. This endpoint should support pagination, and allow filtering of the logs by user ID, date, and type of change.
Implement a front-end interface for the admin dashboard to display the wishlist change logs. Include filtering options for date, user, and type of change, and pagination control for the log entries.

Develop functionality in the front-end to allow admins to revert changes directly from the wishlist audit log interface. This should include confirmation prompts before reverting any changes to prevent accidental reverts.

Ensure comprehensive testing of the new log capturing system and the admin interface functionality. Test cases should include scenarios for all types of changes, filters, pagination, and reverting changes.
Deploy the changes to a staging environment for integration testing with other system components to ensure compatibility and performance stability.
Prepare documentation for system administrators on how to use the new features in the admin dashboard, including how to access the logs, interpret them, use filters, and revert changes.

E003.Epic Description: Create a module that enables administrators to manage user wishlists, including adding, editing, or deleting wishlist items, and to oversee how these lists are used and managed within the application.
E003.Story Description: As a System Administrator, I want to configure notifications for changes to wishlists so that users can be informed of modifications by the admin team.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Admin can enable or disable notifications for specific types of wishlist changes such as additions, deletions, or modifications.
The system should offer customizable templates for notifications sent to users.
Notifications must be sent automatically based on admin settings.
Admin should be able to review a log of all sent notifications.

Tasks.Description: Design and implement a notification settings module in the admin dashboard where admins can enable or disable notifications for specific types of wishlist changes, including additions, deletions, or modifications.

Create customizable email notification templates within the system that can be used to inform users about changes to their wishlists. Templates should include variables for user name, change type, item details, and timestamps.
Develop an automatic notification dispatch functionality that triggers sending of emails to users based on the configurations set by the admin in the notification settings module.
Implement a logging mechanism that records all sent notifications along with details like recipient, time, type of change, and whether the email was successfully sent or failed.
Integrate a review interface within the admin dashboard where administrators can view and filter the log of sent notifications by date, type of change, and recipient.
Ensure that the notification system adheres to privacy and data protection regulations by only including necessary user information and providing secure data transmission.

E004.Epic Description: Ensure the web application adheres to relevant security standards and data protection regulations, implementing necessary security measures to protect user data and system integrity.
E004.Story Description: As a System Administrator, I want the web application to implement secure authentication mechanisms so that user credentials are protected against unauthorized access.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Authentication uses a secure hash algorithm for password storage.
Implements multi-factor authentication for added security.
Provides detailed logs of authentication attempts for monitoring.

Tasks.Description: Implement an authentication module that utilizes a secure hash algorithm, like bcrypt, to hash user passwords before storing them in the database. Ensure that the module properly salts each password to defend against rainbow table attacks.

Develop a multi-factor authentication (MFA) mechanism that supports at least two forms of authentication (e.g., password, SMS code, email token, or authenticator app). This feature should be optional but recommended during user setup, and mandatory for system administrators.

Create a logging system that captures all authentication attempts, including successful logins and failed login attempts. The logs should include timestamp, user identifier, IP address, and the success or failure status. Store these logs securely and make them accessible only to authorized personnel.
Set up a configuration option in the admin panel to enable or disable MFA for users, allowing administrators to enforce or relax security policies as needed.
Integrate the authentication module with existing user management workflows, ensuring that all login and password reset processes utilize the new secure hashing and MFA mechanisms.
Conduct a security review of the new authentication mechanisms with an internal or external security expert to ensure they meet industry standards and best practices.
Prepare documentation for the system administrators detailing how to manage and monitor the new authentication logs, including how to interpret the log entries and respond to suspicious activities.

E004.Epic Description: Ensure the web application adheres to relevant security standards and data protection regulations, implementing necessary security measures to protect user data and system integrity.
E004.Story Title: Data Encryption at Rest and Transit
E004.Story Description: As a System Administrator, I want all sensitive user data to be encrypted both at rest and in transit so that the integrity and confidentiality of user data are maintained.
Story Acceptance Criteria: All sensitive data stored in databases must be encrypted using industry-standard encryption protocols.
All data transmitted over the network must be encrypted using HTTPS or other secure protocols.
Regular audits to verify the implementation of encryption standards.

Tasks.Description: Research and select industry-standard encryption protocols suitable for encrypting sensitive user data at rest, such as AES or RSA.
Implement encryption of sensitive data at rest using the selected protocol. Ensure encryption covers all critical data fields stored in the database.
Configure HTTPS for all data in transit. Ensure that all web traffic, API calls, and data exchanges are conducted over secure, encrypted connections using TLS 1.2 or higher.
Develop and integrate a system function to automatically enforce HTTPS for all incoming and outgoing communications to prevent data interception.
Set up a regular audit process to check and verify the implementation and effectiveness of encryption standards. This should include both automated system checks and manual review components.
Create a detailed audit report format that logs the findings from each encryption standards audit, noting any vulnerabilities found and the actions taken to address them.
Develop a protocol for updating encryption methods and configurations as new threats emerge and standards evolve, ensuring ongoing compliance with industry best practices.

E004.Epic Description: Ensure the web application adheres to relevant security standards and data protection regulations, implementing necessary security measures to protect user data and system integrity.
E004.Story Description: As a System Administrator, I want the application to undergo regular security audits so that any vulnerabilities can be identified and remediated promptly to maintain system security.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Conduct bi-annual security audits using a reputable third-party security firm.
Audit results must be documented and reviewed by the development team.
Implement recommendations from the audit findings within a reasonable timeframe.

Tasks.Description: Identify and select a reputable third-party security firm specialized in web application security auditing. Ensure that the firm has proven experience and positive reviews in conducting thorough security audits.
Establish a contract with the chosen security firm that specifies the scope of the bi-annual audits, including areas to be audited, techniques to be used, and the expected deliverables.
Schedule the initial security audit with the third-party firm. Ensure that the timing aligns with the application development lifecycle to allow for actionable recommendations before major releases.

Develop an internal protocol for the development team to prepare for the audit. This includes ensuring access to necessary resources, documentation, and system credentials for the auditing team, while maintaining security and confidentiality.

Receive the audit report from the third-party firm. Organize a review meeting with the development, security, and project management teams to analyze the findings and prioritize issues based on their severity and impact.
Document the audit findings and the decisions made during the review meeting. Ensure that the documentation is clear, comprehensive, and stored securely for future reference and compliance purposes.
Create a detailed action plan to address the audit findings. Assign tasks to relevant team members, set deadlines, and define clear outcomes to ensure the implementation of the recommendations.
Implement the necessary changes to the application based on the audit recommendations. This may include patching vulnerabilities, enhancing security protocols, and updating compliance measures.
Conduct a follow-up review with the development and security teams to ensure all implemented changes are functioning as expected without introducing new issues.
Prepare and conduct a meeting with the third-party auditing firm to discuss the actions taken and validate that all major issues have been satisfactorily resolved.
Document the final closure of audit findings and any ongoing security measures that need to be monitored. Update the security policies and procedures accordingly.

Plan for the next bi-annual audit by evaluating the outcomes of the current audit cycle and adjusting the audit scope to cover new areas as needed based on recent technology updates and threat landscapes.

E004.Epic Description: Ensure the web application adheres to relevant security standards and data protection regulations, implementing necessary security measures to protect user data and system integrity.
E004.Story Description: As a System Administrator, I want the web application to have a robust role-based access control system so that users can only access features and data relevant to their roles, ensuring system security and data privacy.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Define and implement at least three user roles with specific access rights.
Enforce access restrictions based on user roles at all points of interaction within the application.
Regularly review and update access rights as necessary.

Tasks.Description: Define the three essential user roles and their respective access rights. This task involves identifying the key functionalities of the web application and determining what access each role should have.
Develop a database schema to store user roles and their permissions. This will include creating tables for roles, permissions, and a mapping between users and their roles.

Implement role-based access control (RBAC) logic in the application's backend. This involves coding the functionality to check a user's role and permissions when attempting to access various parts of the application.
Integrate the RBAC system with existing authentication mechanisms to ensure that role checks are performed at each point of user interaction with the application.

Create unit tests to ensure the RBAC system correctly grants and restricts access based on user roles. This will include tests for each role and its permissions across various application functionalities.
Develop an administrative interface for managing user roles. This interface should allow system administrators to add, remove, or modify roles and their permissions.
Set up a review process to regularly assess and update the access rights and roles as necessary. This will involve creating documentation on the process and scheduling regular review meetings.

Document the RBAC system implementation details, including the roles, permissions, and the logic used for access control. This documentation will be useful for both ongoing maintenance and for new developers.
Conduct training sessions for system administrators to educate them on managing and using the new RBAC system effectively.

E004.Epic Description: Ensure the web application adheres to relevant security standards and data protection regulations, implementing necessary security measures to protect user data and system integrity.
E004.Story Title: Compliance with GDPR and Other Regulations
E004.Story Description: As a System Administrator, I want the web application to comply with GDPR and other relevant data protection regulations so that the application is legally compliant and user trust is maintained.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Implement mechanisms for users to view, download, and delete their data.
Ensure all data collection and processing activities have user consent where required.
Regular training for staff on GDPR compliance and data handling procedures.

Tasks.Description: Design and implement a user interface that allows users to view their personal data stored within the application. The interface must be secure and require user authentication before displaying data.
Develop functionality that enables users to download their personal data in a standard format (e.g., CSV, JSON) upon request. Ensure the download process is logged and secure.

Create a feature that allows users to request deletion of their account and associated data. Implement a verification process to confirm the user's identity before deletion and provide a confirmation message post-deletion.
Update data collection forms and processes to include explicit user consent checkboxes for each type of data collection and usage, accompanied by clear information about how the data will be used.
Implement a logging mechanism to record all user consents, including timestamps and the specific data use consented to, ensuring that logs are immutable and securely stored.
Develop and deploy a training program for all staff members on GDPR compliance and best practices in data handling. The program should include regular updates to reflect changes in legislation.
Establish a schedule for regular training sessions and maintain records of staff participation and completion of GDPR compliance training.
Perform a regular review of all data handling and processing activities to ensure continued compliance with GDPR and other relevant privacy regulations, documenting any changes and updates.

E004.Epic Description: Ensure the web application adheres to relevant security standards and data protection regulations, implementing necessary security measures to protect user data and system integrity.
E004.Story Description: As a System Administrator, I want the web application to have secure logging and monitoring mechanisms so that I can track all system activities and detect potential security threats early.
Story Acceptance Criteria: All logs must be encrypted and stored securely.
Implement real-time monitoring tools to detect and alert on suspicious activities.
Logs should include user actions, system errors, and access attempts.

Tasks.Description: Design and implement a secure logging system that encrypts all logs. Specify the encryption algorithms (e.g., AES-256) to be used for encrypting the logs before storage.
Select and integrate a database or storage system that supports encrypted data storage to store the encrypted logs securely.
Develop a function to handle the encryption and decryption processes, ensuring that only authorized system administrators can decrypt and view the logs.

Implement a logging framework within the application that captures all user actions, system errors, and access attempts. Ensure that each log entry includes a timestamp, user identifier, and the type of action.
Select and integrate real-time monitoring tools that can detect and alert on suspicious activities. Tools should be capable of monitoring various system parameters and log entries in real-time.
Configure the monitoring tools to send real-time alerts to system administrators via email or SMS when potential security threats are detected.
Create documentation for the logging and monitoring systems that includes setup instructions, how to interpret the logs, and how to respond to alerts.
Implement regular expression checks or heuristic analysis within the monitoring system to identify patterns that may indicate malicious activities or system anomalies.

Conduct a security review of the logging and monitoring implementations to ensure that they meet the required security standards and are effectively capturing and alerting on security-relevant events.
Prepare a training session for system administrators on how to use the new logging and monitoring tools, including how to respond to alerts and investigate potential security incidents.

E005.Epic Description: Develop a comprehensive system monitoring and reporting framework that allows administrators to monitor system performance, user activities, and security logs to ensure smooth operations.
E005.Story Description: As a System Administrator, I want a feature to log all user activities so that I can review actions taken by users within the system for security and operational audits.
Story Acceptance Criteria: All user actions are logged with a timestamp and user identifier.
Logs are stored securely and are accessible only to authorized administrators.
The system provides filters to view logs by user, date, and type of activity.

Tasks.Description: Design a schema for user activity logs that includes fields for user identifier, action details, and timestamp. Ensure the schema supports efficient querying and data retrieval.
Implement a logging function in Python that captures user actions within the system. This function should populate the log entries with user identifier, action details, and the current timestamp.

Develop a secure storage solution for user activity logs, ensuring that the database or file system used provides encryption and access control mechanisms to protect the data from unauthorized access.

Create an administrative interface that allows authorized administrators to view and filter the user activity logs. The interface should provide filters for user identifier, date range, and type of activity.
Integrate the logging function across various user interactions within the system to ensure all relevant actions are captured. This includes user login, profile updates, and system settings changes.
Test the logging and retrieval functionality to confirm that logs are correctly recorded and can be accessed and filtered by authorized administrators. Include testing for performance and security.
Document the logging system's architecture and usage guidelines, ensuring that future maintenance and enhancements can be carried out efficiently.

E005.Epic Description: Develop a comprehensive system monitoring and reporting framework that allows administrators to monitor system performance, user activities, and security logs to ensure smooth operations.
E005.Story Description: As a System Administrator, I want to monitor system performance in real-time so that I can quickly identify and address performance bottlenecks or failures.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Real-time performance metrics (CPU, memory usage, network status) are displayed on a dashboard.
Performance thresholds can be set, with alerts triggered when these thresholds are exceeded.
The dashboard is updated automatically without needing to refresh the page.

Tasks.Description: Design a dashboard interface for displaying real-time system performance metrics such as CPU usage, memory usage, and network status. The dashboard should be user-friendly and allow administrators to quickly understand the current system performance.

Develop backend functionality to capture real-time performance data from the system. This includes integrating with system APIs or using appropriate tools to fetch metrics like CPU load, memory usage, and network traffic data.

Implement a data refresh mechanism in the dashboard that updates the performance metrics automatically without manual page refresh. This can be achieved by using WebSockets or polling mechanisms to fetch the latest data at regular intervals.

Create a configuration panel in the dashboard where administrators can set performance thresholds for metrics such as CPU usage, memory load, and network traffic. These thresholds will be used to trigger alerts.

Develop an alert system that monitors performance metrics against the set thresholds and triggers notifications when any metric exceeds its threshold. This system should be capable of sending alerts through email or other notification systems to administrators.

Ensure all data processing and alert generation processes are secure and comply with best practices to prevent unauthorized access and data leaks. This includes securing API endpoints, using HTTPS for data transfers, and implementing proper authentication and authorization checks.

Conduct testing to verify that the dashboard displays real-time data accurately, the performance thresholds are respected, alerts are triggered appropriately, and the page updates automatically without refreshing. Include unit tests, integration tests, and user acceptance testing.

Prepare documentation that covers the dashboard functionality, configuration options, alert system operation, and troubleshooting steps. This documentation should be accessible to system administrators for reference and training purposes.

E005.Epic Description: Develop a comprehensive system monitoring and reporting framework that allows administrators to monitor system performance, user activities, and security logs to ensure smooth operations.
E005.Story Description: As a System Administrator, I want to monitor security logs to detect any unauthorized access or potential security threats.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Security logs are compiled in a central repository.
The system provides an interface to search and filter security logs by severity, date, and type of threat.
Alerts are sent to administrators in case of detected high-severity threats.

Tasks.Description: Design and implement a central repository for storing security logs. This repository should ensure data integrity and be scalable to accommodate growing data volumes.

Develop a service that collects security logs from various system components and transfers them to the central repository. This service should handle logs in real-time and ensure secure data transmission.

Create an API for the central repository that allows querying and retrieval of log data. This API should support queries by severity, date, and threat type, and ensure responses are generated efficiently.

Implement a user interface that connects to the API for the central repository, allowing administrators to search and filter the security logs. The interface should be intuitive and provide facilities for complex query capabilities.

Develop a rule-based engine that analyzes log entries in real-time to detect patterns indicative of high-severity threats. This engine should be configurable to allow updates and refinements to detection rules.

Integrate an alert system with the rule-based engine to send notifications to administrators via email or SMS when a high-severity threat is detected. This system should include provisions for immediate actions or escalations.

Perform comprehensive testing of the security log system to ensure all components work together seamlessly and that the system meets all specified requirements regarding data handling, performance, and security.

Document the architecture and usage of the system, including API endpoints, user interface guides, and configuration instructions for the rule-based detection engine. Ensure that the documentation is accessible to all relevant system administrators.

E005.Epic Description: Develop a comprehensive system monitoring and reporting framework that allows administrators to monitor system performance, user activities, and security logs to ensure smooth operations.
E005.Story Description: As a System Administrator, I want to generate system health reports so that I can provide regular updates on system status and compliance with performance standards.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Administrators can generate customizable reports on system performance and security status.
Reports can be exported in various formats (PDF, CSV, HTML).
The system stores historical report data for comparison over time.

Tasks.Description: Design a system report interface that allows administrators to select report parameters such as date range, system performance metrics, and security status indicators.
Implement backend functionality to retrieve system performance data such as CPU usage, memory usage, and network status from system monitoring tools.
Develop a mechanism to fetch and compile security logs from various system components into a centralized repository for reporting.
Create a feature in the system report interface to allow administrators to customize the layout and content of the reports according to their needs.
Implement functionality to generate reports in multiple formats including PDF, CSV, and HTML based on the administrator's selection.
Develop a storage solution to archive generated reports and maintain historical report data for comparison over time.
Ensure the system report generation process adheres to performance standards, with a focus on minimizing the impact on system resources and ensuring report accuracy.
Integrate the report generation module with existing system monitoring and security tools to automatically pull the latest data for reporting.
Implement comprehensive testing of the report generation functionality to ensure reports are accurate, adhere to the customizable parameters, and are generated within performance benchmarks.
Develop a user guide and provide training for administrators on how to use the new reporting tools effectively.

E005.Epic Description: Develop a comprehensive system monitoring and reporting framework that allows administrators to monitor system performance, user activities, and security logs to ensure smooth operations.
E005.Story Description: As a System Administrator, I want an alert system for unusual user activities so that I can take immediate action to prevent potential breaches or misuse of the system.
Story Acceptance Criteria: The system analyzes user activities and flags activities that deviate from normal patterns.
Administrators receive real-time alerts of these unusual activities.
Administrators can customize the parameters that define normal vs. unusual activity.

Tasks.Description: Design and implement a user activity monitoring module that captures all user interactions within the system, cataloging actions such as login attempts, data access, and modifications.
Develop algorithms capable of analyzing user activities to identify patterns and detect deviations based on predefined criteria such as frequency, timing, and type of action.
Create a real-time alert system that triggers notifications to administrators when unusual activities are detected. This system should include various alert channels like email or SMS.
Implement a configuration interface for administrators to customize parameters that define normal and unusual activities. This includes setting thresholds and sensitivity of the detection algorithms.
Ensure the monitoring and alert system is able to operate in real-time, providing timely detection and notifications without significant delays.
Develop a secure, scalable storage solution for logging and retrieving user activity data, ensuring data integrity and compliance with data protection regulations.
Integrate the user activity monitoring and alert system with existing security infrastructure, including role-based access controls and secure authentication mechanisms.
Conduct rigorous testing of the user activity monitoring and alert system to validate its effectiveness in flagging unusual activities and the reliability of real-time alerts.
Prepare documentation for system administrators outlining how to use and configure the monitoring system, including details on how to interpret alerts and investigate flagged activities.
